messages:
Priya: Planning a staggered runtime deploy tonight (2026-03-21 23:00 UTC). Regions: eu-west then us-west. Change window 60m. Will include runtime 1.3.2 -> 1.4.0 + model-store table migration for Dedicated pools. Need concise statuspage + customer email copies.

Liam: I can assemble both. Proposed abort criteria?

Priya: Abort if canary error rate > 1% for 5m or p95 latency increase > 300ms baseline. On abort we will rollback and pin affected Dedicated customers to 1.3.2.

DeployBot: Deploy scheduled by priya: region=eu-west, start=2026-03-21T23:00:00Z, canary=10m, stagger=eu-west->us-west, change_window=60m. Manual hold allowed.

Casey: Ops preflight checklist:
- 22:20 UTC: snapshot model-store tables
- 22:30 UTC: pre-warm LRU caches for top tenants
- 22:40 UTC: stop non-critical batch jobs in eu-west
- 22:50 UTC: run infra smoke: ./ops/smoke_check.sh
If any preflight step fails we don't start and we post a preflight-failed incident.

Nora: Rollback flow: hit manual hold -> run ops/rollback_runtime.sh -> patch runtime routes -> pin tenants -> notify customers. Kevin from oncall will monitor first 20m and can trigger immediate rollback.

Liam: Draft statuspage blurb (short):
``
Planned maintenance: 21 Mar 2026 23:00 UTC (eu-west, us-west)
We will perform a runtime upgrade of our inference service. Window up to 60 minutes. Some Dedicated pools may be pinned to the previous runtime (v1.3.2) to maintain stability if issues are detected.
Start: 2026-03-21 23:00 UTC
Expected duration: up to 60 minutes
Impact: Possible elevated latency or brief errors for a subset of Dedicated customers.
``

Priya: Email subject: "Planned maintenance: inference runtime upgrade — 21 Mar 23:00 UTC"

Liam: Email body draft (concise):
``
Hello,
We will upgrade our inference runtime on 21 Mar at 23:00 UTC for eu-west and us-west. The maintenance window is up to 60 minutes. During the update, some Dedicated pools may experience higher latency or transient errors. If we detect instability we will pin affected Dedicated customers to the previous runtime (v1.3.2) to preserve availability.
If you have critical workloads during this period, please reply to this message or contact support@redwood.ai to request a carve-out.
Regards,
Redwood Inference Ops
``

Casey: Add enterprise contact + phone number for carve-outs in the email. Also add that we will not retry automatic model uploads during migration; ops will retry after validation.

Liam: Added enterprise contact line and the model-upload note. I'll post to statuspage and schedule email to dedicated-cust at 22:00 and 22:45 as reminders.

Nora: Oncall presence: I'll be available for canary and first 30m. If DeployBot reports any infra-level errors I'll flip the manual hold and post here.

Priya: Thanks team. When DeployBot starts, please paste the deploy log URL here and update at +5m intervals.
